text:
Nora (CS): Quick heads-up 18 discrete asks from last onboarding wave. I'm grouping them into clusters but want PM/Eng eyes before we promise anything. Triage reactions: :rocket: = roadmap candidate, :mag: = needs research/UX, :warning: = renewal risk

feedback-bot: Uploaded onboarding_calls_2026_04_05.csv (18 rows). Auto-tags: embeddings, per-route-billing, docs, long-context-latency.

Ethan (PM): Can we sort the sheet by ARR and "time-to-fix"? High ARR + low-effort = obvious wins.

Riya (Product Ops): Done. Added columns: arr_bucket, owner_suggested, effort_est. Shared: https://redwood.internal/sheets/triage-1767770000 (placeholder)

Nora (CS): Quick paste of top 4 rows from the sheet for visibility:
```
customer,tier,arr_bucket,short_ask
BrightBridge,A,>200k,option to route embeddings per-route to different model sizes to save cost
NovaRetail,B,50-200k,per-route billing breakdown in console for multi-team billing
HelioHealth,A,>200k,reduce tail latency for 8k+ token sessions
MicroSaaS,C,<50k,clarity in docs: "how to set cache TTL" and examples
```

Diego (Eng): BrightBridges embeddings routing is mostly a routing-layer config + model aliasing. Low-risk. I can prototype a RBAC-safe toggle.

Priya (SE): For NovaRetail billing ask, can CS attach sample invoices and per-route usage? Helps recreate their billing view.

Nora (CS): Uploading sample invoices now. Marking NovaRetail as follow-up for finance screencast.

Ethan (PM): Reacting :rocket: to BrightBridge (clear ROI) and :mag: to MicroSaaS docs ask (low effort but needs copy review).

Nora (CS): Flagging HelioHealth as :warning: renewal risk 1 they repeatedly called out latency in two onboarding sessions.

feedback-bot: Note: 4 accounts tagged by CS as "high churn risk": HelioHealth, BrightBridge, TerraFleet, NovaRetail.

Diego (Eng): HelioHealths profile looks like long-sequence KV-cache pressure. I'll do a perf spike test and report a quick mitigation (kv-prefetch + adjusted batching).

Riya (Product Ops): Scheduling a 20-min rapid triage tomorrow 09:30 PT. Agenda: 1) HelioHealth mitigation options, 2) BrightBridge embed routing PoC, 3) NovaRetail billing artifacts + owner assigns. Invite: @Ethan @Diego @Nora @Priya

Priya (SE): I'll collect example API logs and a sample_embedding_request for HelioHealth before the triage.

Nora (CS): One process ask: can Eng/PM call out any items that are "non-starters" (privacy/regulatory) so CS stops suggesting timelines?

Diego (Eng): Nothing regulatory here. If a request requires customer-side network changes (private deploy VPN setup) we'll escalate.

Ethan (PM): After the triage, I'll convert roadmap candidates into epics and add owners. Riya, please track meeting notes in the sheet.

Riya (Product Ops): Will do. I'll also create Jira tickets for BrightBridge (epic/prototype) and NovaRetail (investigate billing view).

Nora (CS): Thanks team 1 will ping accounts after triage with expected next steps. :thumbsup:
